title: Type 1 & Type 2 Diabetes
details: Customized treatment plans including insulin therapy management, dietary counseling, and ongoing A1C monitoring to prevent long-term complications.

title: CGM & Insulin Pump Support
details: Expert setup, data interpretation, and continuous support for modern Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGM) and automated insulin delivery systems.

title: Thyroid & Parathyroid
details: Diagnosis and ongoing management for hypothyroidism, hyperthyroidism, thyroid nodules, Hashimoto's disease, and calcium disorders.

title: Gestational & Metabolic Care
details: Focused care for pregnancy-related blood sugar control, PCOS, metabolic syndrome, and preventative lifestyle interventions.
